record.paper_title: Traces on Operator Ideals Defined over the Class of all Banach Spaces and Related Open Problems
record.original_question: For 1 ≤ r < ∞, let LWEYL_{r,∞} be the quasi-Banach operator ideal defined by the dyadic Weyl-number condition x_{2^k}(S) = O(2^{-k/r}). Determine whether the interpolated ideals (LWEYL_{r,∞})APP_{r,∞} strictly increase as r varies over [2,∞), or whether they become constant on that range; in particular, decide whether (LWEYL_{2,∞})APP_{2,∞} might already equal LWEYL_{1,∞}.

evidence.quote: Letting 0 < r ≤ ∞, we define the quasi-Banach operator ideal LWEYL_{r,∞} := { S ∈ L : x_{2^k}(S) = O(1/2^{k/r}) }.
Problem 12. Find out whether (LWEYL_{r,∞})APP_{r,∞} strictly increases with the exponent r ∈ [2,∞) or is constant. Even (LWEYL_{2,∞})APP_{2,∞} = LWEYL_{1,∞} should be taken into account.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $\mathcal{L}$ denote the class of all bounded linear operators between Banach spaces. For an operator $S \in \mathcal{L}(X,Y)$, the $n$-th Weyl number $x_n(S)$ is defined by
$$x_n(S) = \sup\{a_n(S A) : A \in \mathcal{L}(\ell_2, X),\ \|A\| \le 1\},$$
where $a_n(\cdot)$ denotes the $n$-th approximation number, i.e. $a_n(T) = \inf\{\|T - R\| : R \text{ has rank} < n\}$.

For $1 \le r < \infty$, define the quasi-Banach operator ideal
$$\mathcal{L}^{\mathrm{WEYL}}_{r,\infty} := \{S \in \mathcal{L} : x_{2^k}(S) = O(2^{-k/r}) \text{ as } k \to \infty\}.$$

For an operator ideal $\mathcal{A}$, let $\mathcal{A}^{\mathrm{APP}}_{r,\infty}$ denote the ideal obtained from $\mathcal{A}$ by the $(r,\infty)$-approximation-number interpolation procedure: $S \in \mathcal{A}^{\mathrm{APP}}_{r,\infty}$ if and only if there exists a factorization-type representation such that the approximation numbers $a_{2^k}(S)$ decay like $2^{-k/r}$ relative to operators in $\mathcal{A}$ (equivalently, $\mathcal{A}^{\mathrm{APP}}_{r,\infty}$ is the Lorentz-type ideal of order $(r,\infty)$ generated from $\mathcal{A}$ via approximation numbers).

Question: Does the family of ideals
$$\bigl(\mathcal{L}^{\mathrm{WEYL}}_{r,\infty}\bigr)^{\mathrm{APP}}_{r,\infty},\qquad r \in [2,\infty),$$
strictly increase with $r$, or is it constant on the interval $[2,\infty)$? In particular, decide whether the equality
$$\bigl(\mathcal{L}^{\mathrm{WEYL}}_{2,\infty}\bigr)^{\mathrm{APP}}_{2,\infty} = \mathcal{L}^{\mathrm{WEYL}}_{1,\infty}$$
holds.
artifact.status_search_result: No published resolution of this specific question about the monotonicity (or constancy) of the interpolated Weyl-generated ideals $(\mathcal{L}^{\mathrm{WEYL}}_{r,\infty})^{\mathrm{APP}}_{r,\infty}$ for $r \in [2,\infty)$ was found. It is listed as one of the open problems in the recent survey on traces of operator ideals on Banach spaces and no follow-up work resolving it appears in standard searches.

status_evidence.snippet: Survey listing problems concerning Weyl-generated ideals and their interpolation properties.
